function.name: create_Recommender_Model
function.description: This function is used to create a recommendation model using a given user data and an algorithm type Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_data.description: A data frame of user ratings. Rows represent users, columns represent items, and entries represent user ratings for items

algorithm.description: The algorithm to be used for creating the recommendation model. Collaborative filtering, content-based filtering and hybrid filtering.

matrix_factorization.description: Optional parameter to indicate whether matrix factorization should be used. Default is False.

Below is a **step‑by‑step playbook** you can follow to build a modern, production‑ready frontend for an e‑commerce site. I’ve grouped the work into logical phases, added concrete examples, and linked to the most useful tools and libraries. Feel free to skip or reorder sections based on your team’s skill set and project scope. --- ## 1️⃣ Planning & Design | What | Why | How | |------|-----|-----| | **User stories & journey map** | Clarifies what the customer needs (search, filter, cart, checkout, etc.) | Use Miro, Figma, or a simple whiteboard | | **Wireframes / High‑fidelity mockups** | Visual blueprint before coding | Figma → export assets → design tokens | | **Design system / component library** | Reusable UI, consistent look & feel | Create a Storybook repo or use an existing one (e.g., Material‑UI, Chakra‑UI) | | **Accessibility audit** | WCAG 2.1 AA compliance | Run axe‑devtools, Lighthouse, or a manual checklist | > **Tip:** Keep the design mobile‑first. Start with a 320 px breakpoint and scale up. --- ## 2️⃣ Choose Your Tech Stack | Layer | Recommendation | Reason | |-------|----------------|--------| | **Framework** | **Next.js** (React) or **Nuxt.js** (Vue) | Built‑in SSR/SSG, file‑based routing, API routes | | **State** | **Redux Toolkit** or **Zustand** | Predictable global state for cart, auth, etc. | | **Styling** | **Tailwind CSS** + **PostCSS** | Utility‑first, easy theming, dark mode | | **Component library** | **Shadcn/ui** (Radix + Tailwind) | Accessible primitives, ready for dark mode | | **Type system** | **TypeScript** | Compile‑time safety, better IDE support | | **Testing** | **Jest** + **React Testing Library** | Unit & integration tests | | **E2E** | **Cypress** | End‑to‑end flows (checkout, login, etc.) | | **CI/CD** | **GitHub Actions** | Simple, integrates with Vercel/Netlify | | **Hosting** | **Vercel** (or Netlify) | Zero‑config, automatic SSR/SSG, edge functions | | **Analytics** | **Google Analytics 4** + **Sentry** | Traffic + error monitoring | | **Payments** | **Stripe** (Checkout or Elements) | PCI‑compliant, easy to integrate | | **Auth** | **Auth0** or **Firebase Auth** | OAuth, social logins, MFA | > **Alternative**: If you prefer a headless CMS, pair the frontend with **Sanity.io** or **Strapi** for product data. --- ## 3️⃣ Project Skeleton ```bash my-ecommerce/ ├─ public/ │ ├─ images/ │ └─ favicon.ico ├─ src/ │ ├─ components/ │ │ ├─ ui/ # Shadcn primitives │ │ └─ ProductCard.tsx │ ├─ pages/ │ │ ├─ index.tsx # Home / product grid │ │ ├─ product/[id].tsx │ │ ├─ cart.tsx │ │ └─ checkout.tsx │ ├─ hooks/ │ │ └─ useCart.ts │ ├─ store/ │ │ └─ cartSlice.ts │ ├─ lib/ │ │ └─ api.ts # Axios instance │ ├─ styles/ │ │ └─ globals.css │ └─ types/ │ └─ index.d.ts ├─ .env.local ├─ next.config.js ├─ tailwind.config.js ├─ postcss.config.js ├─ jest.config.js ├─ cypress.config.js └─ package.json ``` --- ## 4️⃣ Core Features – Quick Code Snippets ### 4.1 Product Grid (SSR) ```tsx // pages/index.tsx import { GetServerSideProps } from 'next'; import axios from '@/lib/api'; import ProductCard from '@/components/ProductCard'; export default function Home({ products }) { return (
{products.map(p => )}
); } export const getServerSideProps: GetServerSideProps = async () => { const { data } = await axios.get('/products'); return { props: { products: data } }; }; ``` ### 4.2 Cart State (Redux Toolkit) ```ts // store/cartSlice.ts import { createSlice, PayloadAction } from '@reduxjs/toolkit'; interface CartItem { id: string; quantity: number; price: number; } interface CartState { items: CartItem[]; } const initialState: CartState = { items: [] }; export const cartSlice = createSlice({ name: 'cart', initialState, reducers: { addItem(state, action: PayloadAction) { const existing = state.items.find(i => i.id === action.payload.id); if (existing) existing.quantity += action.payload.quantity; else state.items.push(action.payload); }, removeItem(state, action: PayloadAction) { state.items = state.items.filter(i => i.id !== action.payload); }, clearCart(state) { state.items = []; }, }, }); export const { addItem, removeItem, clearCart } = cartSlice.actions; export default cartSlice.reducer; ``` ### 4.3 Checkout Flow (Stripe Elements) ```tsx // pages/checkout.tsx import { loadStripe } from '@stripe/stripe-js'; import { Elements } from '@stripe/react-stripe-js'; import CheckoutForm from '@/components/CheckoutForm'; const stripePromise = loadStripe(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!); export default function Checkout() { return ( ); } ``` ### 4.4 API Wrapper ```ts // lib/api.ts import axios from 'axios'; const api = axios.create({ baseURL: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, }); export default api; ``` --- ## 5️⃣ Performance & SEO | Technique | Tool | How | |-----------|------|-----| | **Image optimization** | `next/image` | Automatic resizing, WebP, lazy loading | | **Code splitting** | Next.js dynamic imports | `dynamic(() => import('./HeavyComponent'))` | | **Caching** | Vercel Edge Cache | Set `Cache-Control` headers in API routes | | **SEO** | `next/head`, `next-seo` | Meta tags, Open Graph, structured data | | **Accessibility** | axe, Lighthouse | Run on CI (`npm run lint:accessibility`) | | **Core Web Vitals** | Lighthouse CI | `npx lighthouse-ci --build` | --- ## 6️⃣ Testing Strategy | Test Type | Tool | Example | |-----------|------|---------| | **Unit** | Jest + React Testing Library | `render(
